description: Start a release gate run: its tests run against the agent and the gate decides pass or fail against its threshold. Returns the gate run's number; follow it with get_gate_run until finished is true. Use it when the user asks whether a change is safe to release. In CI, use the gate's deploy key with `qualiloop gate run` instead.
